title: Lifting a derived complex for a projective class
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal, $\mathcal P$ a class of $R$-modules, $K\in D(R)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $E^\bullet$ a complex of $R/I$-modules representing $K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R/I$ in $D(R/I)$. Assume: (1) every member of $\mathcal P$ is projective; (2) $P_1\in\mathcal P$ and $P_1\oplus P_2\in\mathcal P$ if and only if $P_1,P_2\in\mathcal P$; (3) every map $f:P_1\to P_2$ with $P_1,P_2\in\mathcal P$ that is surjective modulo $I$ is surjective; (4) $E^\bullet$ is bounded above and each $E^i$ is isomorphic to $P/IP$ for some $P\in\mathcal P$; and (5) $K$ is represented by a bounded-above complex with terms in $\mathcal P$. Then $K$ is represented by a bounded-above complex $P^\bullet$ with terms in $\mathcal P$ whose termwise quotient $P^\bullet/IP^\bullet$ is isomorphic to $E^\bullet$ as a complex.
